# Pressure Difference Pressure difference, or ΔP, is the difference in pressure between two areas. This difference can exert force on objects between those areas, dealing [bold]pressure damage[/bold] to some of them.
Various glass objects, such as windows, windoors, and shutters, can take pressure damage when the ΔP between their two sides is high enough. This damage can shatter those objects, allowing gas to flow freely between the areas.
Different types of objects can withstand different ΔP thresholds before breaking. Generally, the stronger the glass, the higher its threshold. Thin objects also have lower thresholds.
Walls, airlocks, and firelocks are not affected by ΔP.
## Standard Glass and Objects
Full-size standard glass and other weak objects can withstand a ΔP of up to [color=orange][protodata="Window" comp="DeltaPressure" member="MinPressureDelta"/] kPa[/color] before they begin to crack.
Quarter-size glass, such as directional windows, can withstand a ΔP of up to [color=orange][protodata="WindowDirectional" comp="DeltaPressure" member="MinPressureDelta"/] kPa[/color] before it begins to crack.
## Reinforced Glass and Objects
Full-size reinforced glass can withstand a ΔP of up to [color=orange][protodata="ReinforcedWindow" comp="DeltaPressure" member="MinPressureDelta"/] kPa[/color] before it begins to crack.
Quarter-size reinforced glass can withstand a ΔP of up to [color=orange][protodata="WindowReinforcedDirectional" comp="DeltaPressure" member="MinPressureDelta"/] kPa[/color] before it begins to crack.
## Plasma and Uranium Glass
Full-size plasma and uranium glass can withstand a ΔP of up to [color=orange][protodata="PlasmaWindow" comp="DeltaPressure" member="MinPressureDelta"/] kPa[/color] before it begins to crack.
Quarter-size plasma and uranium glass can withstand a ΔP of up to [color=orange][protodata="PlasmaWindowDirectional" comp="DeltaPressure" member="MinPressureDelta"/] kPa[/color] before it begins to crack.
## Reinforced Plasma and Uranium Glass
Full-size reinforced plasma and uranium glass can withstand a ΔP of up to [color=orange][protodata="ReinforcedPlasmaWindow" comp="DeltaPressure" member="MinPressureDelta"/] kPa[/color] before it begins to crack.
Quarter-size reinforced plasma and uranium glass can withstand a ΔP of up to [color=orange][protodata="PlasmaReinforcedWindowDirectional" comp="DeltaPressure" member="MinPressureDelta"/] kPa[/color] before it begins to crack.
